name: Oxandrolone
aliases: Anavar®, Ossandrolone, Oxandrolon, Oxandrolona, Oxandrolonum, Protivar, SC-11585
summary: Oxandrolone is an androgen and synthetic anabolic steroid (AAS) medication to help promote weight gain in various situations, to help offset protein catabolism caused by long-term corticosteroid therapy, to support recovery from severe burns, to treat bone pain associated with osteoporosis, to aid in the development of girls with Turner syndrome, and for other indications. It is taken by mouth.
